people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.
translations.bsb: O daughters of Jerusalem, I adjure you: Do not arouse or awaken love until the time is right.
translations.kjv: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, until he please.
translations.asv: I adjure you, O daughters of Jerusalem, That ye stir not up, nor awake my love, Until he please.
